statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is to capture arrhythmic activity during symptomatic periods
The diagnosis code I49.9 (unspecified cardiac arrhythmia) was submitted
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
